feeds.title: Boundless Blog
feeds.description: Boundless is a community for Christian young adults who want to grow up, own their faith, date with purpose, and prepare for marriage and family. Our goal is to mature young adults in Christ as the foundation for marriage and family while providing an inspiring and refreshingly real online community in which to share the journey.

feeds.title: Cross Walk
feeds.description: Read Christian singles and Christian dating advice with Biblical principles and guidance for women and men in relationships seeking help and tips from the Bible.

feeds.title: Bliss for Singles
feeds.description: B.L.I.S.S. {Black Love & Inspiration for Saved Singles} is a site created to discuss Black Love today and inspire Christian Singles to be the best in their romantic relationships through embracing their most important relationship- with Jesus Christ. The blog is mainly geared towards singles who are interested in being in a godly marriage one day.

feeds.title: Oasis Singles Blog
feeds.description: Christian dating service reviews for Christian singles interested in Christian dating tips, online dating, Christian podcasts, life advice and single groups.

feeds.title: Sophie-sticated Mom
feeds.description: Blog topics cover articles on Christian lifestyle, faith, career, relationships, & affordable fashion & beauty tips for single moms. Dr. Sophia Reed started this single mom blog for sophisticated moms for single mothers who want to put her best foot forward in everything she does, including her relationships, her career, her appearance, her parenting, and her relationship with God.

feeds.title: Tez Brooks Blog
feeds.description: A blog for single Christian fathers trying to find their way. Tez Brooks was a single father for seven years before re-marrying. As the father of four, he has a heart to see single parents succeed in the journey as they lead their children through the brokenness of divorce. His ability to relate with transparency and humor wins readers around the world.

feeds.title: Single Matters Magazine
feeds.description: An online webzine for Christian singles discussing matters of life, relationships, singleness and faith.

feeds.title: True Love Dates
feeds.description: True Love Dates is a community of men and women dedicated to doing relationships well! All the relationship resources you will find here have been created and written by Debra Fileta, a licensed professional counselor, author and national speaker specializing in relationship and marriage issues.

feeds.title: Girl Defined Blog
feeds.description: Hi, we are Kristen and Bethany the Texas sisters and co-authors of Girl Defined and Love Defined. Reclaiming God's design for womanhood. We hope that Girl Defined Ministries will challenge, encourage, and open your eyes to God's incredible design for womanhood.

feeds.title: Justin Campbell
feeds.description: Thoughts on Christ Centered Singleness and the Church.

feeds.title: Christian Connection
feeds.description: Articles on dating and relationship advice and tips for single Christians from Christian Connection blog. Christian Connection is dedicated to supporting and connecting single Christians to find love, friendship, and lasting happiness.
